source_records.governing_condition_default_exception: Fuel is false by default; enabled stores begin with zero fuel. Epoch mode needs a deadline before execution; trap is default, async yield requires async support. Large bulk operations can exceed a slice. Thread compilation and thread spawning are distinct; component async/threading support has incomplete areas.
source_records.applicability: Evidence for one runtime option; does not select Wasmtime or make fuel a complete host-side budget.

critic_review.observed_operation: Official docs.rs Config API search/open result inspected for fuel, epochs, initial fuel/deadline, trap default, bulk operations, and host-blocked calls.
critic_review.governing_condition_default_exception: Fuel is disabled by default; enabling it requires initial fuel. Epoch mode requires a deadline and traps by default; bulk operations and blocking host calls need separate handling.
critic_review.applicability: Corroborates the runtime caveats. Exact inherited 49.0.2 pin was not independently confirmed through the current docs.rs result.
critic_review.identity_note: This is a supplemental review of the inherited stable source ID; original URL, version/commit, locator, and access window remain intact.
